description: Synthetic sesslint.__main__ non-frozen entry parity: python -m sesslint delegates to sesslint.cli.main(); removed-command stderr/stdout only.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-__main__-sys-frozen: Python calls multiprocessing.freeze_support() when sys.frozen is true before sesslint.cli.main(); Rust has no PyInstaller frozen flag and no successful frozen path.

GAP-__main__-unparsed-command: Python __main__ calls sesslint.cli.main() which parses argv through argparse (usage text, exit 2 for partial commands such as check). Rust main__::main stops at sesslint.cli.check.configure is not available with empty stdio; the Python stderr is recorded in vectors, not the Rust error.
